senses.d: Machines or equipment thus designed.
ex: We went to the trade show to see the latest technology on display.

senses.d: Any useful skill or mechanism that humans have developed or invented (including in prescientific eras).
ex: the incipient metalworking technology of the Bronze Age

senses.d: Any useful trait that has evolved in any organism.

senses.d: Specifically related to a particular discipline.
ex: Particle physics uses the word spin in a technical sense.

senses.d: difficult to understand for those not specialized in this discipline.
ex: This part of the article is going to be quite technical but I cannot avoid it. It's a very complex topic.

senses.d: Of or related to technology.
ex: Since the 1940s there had been many technical advancements, and a Mach 3 interceptor was no longer a mere pipe dream.

senses.d: Technically minded; adept with science and technology.
ex: Kayla can probably get the printer working. She's technical like that.

senses.d: Relating to, or requiring, technique.
ex: The performance showed technical virtuosity, but lacked inspiration.

senses.d: Requiring advanced techniques for successful completion.
ex: technical climbing

senses.d: Relating to the internal mechanics of a market rather than more basic factors.
ex: The market had a technical rally, due to an oversold condition.

senses.d: In the strictest sense, but not practically or meaningfully.
ex: Crossing the front lawn of that house to get to the mailbox was a technical trespass.

senses.d: A pickup truck with a gun mounted on it.
A special move in certain fighting games that cancels out the effect of an opponent's attack.

The central rhythmic component is most often in common time (4/4), where time is marked with a bass drum on each quarter note pulse, a backbeat played by snare or clap on the second and fourth pulses of the bar, and an open hi-hat sounding every second eighth note.
